title: Amazing experience
text: I had a fantastic experience with Julia tour company.  We went to Montserrat. Everything was pleasant from start to finish, and the guide was awesome, knowledgeable, and made the trip really enjoyable. Transportation was comfortable.  5 star experience
author: Odyssey40291285096

title: Memorable Montserrat
text: Montserrat is a must-see experience! The combination of history and faith is compelling. The views of the valley, even as far as the Pyrenees are stunning. The tour guide was exceptionally personable and made every guest feel welcomed. Highly recommend!
author: donnamV6350PV

title: Spiritual Beauty in the Mountains
text:
My mom and I took this tour in early December 2025, and it was truly one of the highlights of our trip. From start to finish, everything was well organized and thoughtfully paced. Our guide was personable, knowledgeable, and genuinely attentive, making the experience feel both informative and personal.

Seeing the Black Madonna was wonderful, and the surrounding scenery was absolutely breathtaking, a perfect blend of history, spirituality, and natural beauty. It was a refreshing and memorable escape from the hustle of Barcelona city, offering a deeper and more unique perspective of the region.
author: 645brettn

title: Splendid tour giudes
text: Tour guides knowledgeable and easy to understand.  Other than fog and drizzle wonderful experience. All good
author: Howard_J

title: Breathtaking Views and Fascinating History
text: The guided tour of Montserrat was incredible! Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and shared so many interesting stories about the monastery’s history and the famous Black Madonna. The scenery was absolutely stunning – the mountains are breathtaking, and the views from the top are unforgettable. It was a perfect mix of culture, history, and nature. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Barcelona!
author: Luca C
